description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to oversee all aspects of nursing operations, ensuring the delivery of high-quality patient care and maintaining regulatory compliance. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the resident experience and fostering a supportive environment for our dedicated nursing staff.

As the DON, you will be responsible for clinical leadership, staff development, and upholding the highest standards of care. This role offers a competitive annual salary and the chance to make a significant impact within a compassionate and professional setting. Join a team committed to excellence and resident well-being.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role within a skilled nursing facility.
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care.
Proven leadership, management, and communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000.
